name: 5-Ethoxy-DMT
summary: 5-Ethoxy-DMT, or 5-EtO-DMT, also known as 5-ethoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as O-ethylbufotenine, is a tryptamine derivative which has been previously synthesized as a chemical intermediate, but has not been studied to determine its pharmacology.

uses.text: 5-Ethoxy-DMT, or 5-EtO-DMT, also known as 5-ethoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as O-ethylbufotenine, is a tryptamine derivative which has been previously synthesized as a chemical intermediate, but has not been studied to determine its pharmacology.

summaryZh: 5-乙氧基二甲基色胺，分子式C14H20N2O，是一種色胺衍生物，相關的5-甲氧基色胺同系物有5-甲氧基二甲基色胺等。
summaryZhHans: 5-乙氧基二甲基色胺，分子式C14H20N2O，是一种色胺衍生物，相关的5-甲氧基色胺同系物有5-甲氧基二甲基色胺等。

fact.en: It is also called O-ethylbufotenine, because bufotenine, the compound it is built from, was first isolated from the skin secretions of toads of the genus Bufo.
fact.zh: 它也被稱為O-乙基蟾蜍色胺，因為它所基於的蟾蜍色胺（bufotenine）最早是從蟾蜍屬（Bufo）動物的皮膚分泌物中分離出來的。
fact.zhHans: 它也被称为O-乙基蟾蜍色胺，因为它所基于的蟾蜍色胺（bufotenine）最早是从蟾蜍属（Bufo）动物的皮肤分泌物中分离出来的。
